envelope_adjustment_date_check.name: envelope_adjustment_date_check
envelope_adjustment_date_check.value: "envelope_adjustment"."date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]' AND substr("envelope_adjustment"."date", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12' AND substr("envelope_adjustment"."date", 9, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '31'

family_cadence_day_check.name: family_cadence_day_check
family_cadence_day_check.value: "family"."cadence_day_of_month" IS NULL OR "family"."cadence_day_of_month" = 'last' OR (length("family"."cadence_day_of_month") = 1 AND "family"."cadence_day_of_month" GLOB '[1-9]') OR (length("family"."cadence_day_of_month") = 2 AND "family"."cadence_day_of_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9]' AND "family"."cadence_day_of_month" BETWEEN '10' AND '28')

family_cadence_time_check.name: family_cadence_time_check
family_cadence_time_check.value: "family"."cadence_time" IS NULL OR ("family"."cadence_time" GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr("family"."cadence_time", 1, 2) <= '23')

snapshot_source_external_unique.name: snapshot_source_external_unique
snapshot_source_external_unique.where: "snapshot"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "snapshot"."external_id" IS NOT NULL

snapshot_external_source_check.name: snapshot_external_source_check
snapshot_external_source_check.value: "snapshot"."external_id" IS NULL OR "snapshot"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL

txn_source_external_unique.name: txn_source_external_unique
txn_source_external_unique.where: "txn"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "txn"."external_id" IS NOT NULL

txn_date_check.name: txn_date_check
txn_date_check.value: "txn"."date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]' AND substr("txn"."date", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12' AND substr("txn"."date", 9, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '31'

txn_transfer_check.name: txn_transfer_check
txn_transfer_check.value: "txn"."kind" != 'transfer' OR ("txn"."amount" > 0 AND "txn"."to_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "txn"."to_amount" > 0 AND "txn"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "txn"."to_account_id" != "txn"."account_id" AND "txn"."merchant" IS NULL)

txn_no_transfer_side_check.name: txn_no_transfer_side_check
txn_no_transfer_side_check.value: "txn"."kind" = 'transfer' OR ("txn"."to_account_id" IS NULL AND "txn"."to_amount" IS NULL)

txn_external_source_check.name: txn_external_source_check
txn_external_source_check.value: "txn"."external_id" IS NULL OR "txn"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL

txn_part_envelope_amount_check.name: txn_part_envelope_amount_check
txn_part_envelope_amount_check.value: "txn_part"."envelope_amount" IS NULL OR "txn_part"."envelope_id" IS NOT NULL
